steps.title: Welcome to the AI Lab
steps.text: Here you train a model to make predictions from a dataset. This tour shows you around.

steps.title: Two views
steps.text: Explore and train on the dataset in one view, then test your model in the other.

steps.title: Your dataset
steps.text: Each row is one example. Each column is something you know about it.

steps.title: Train a model
steps.text: Choose what to predict and what to use, then train.

steps.title: Find this tour again
steps.text: Replay any tour from the Resources tab.
